description: Client-side script for the 'Quotation' doctype in ERPNext, managing form behaviors, custom buttons, and interactions related to quotations.

classes.name: erpnext.selling.QuotationController
classes.description: Controller class extending SellingController to handle quotation-specific logic.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Initial load handler for the quotation form.

methods.name: party_name
methods.description: Handles updates when the party name field changes, including fetching lead details.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, sets buttons and dynamic links based on document status.

methods.name: set_dynamic_field_label
methods.description: Sets label and query for 'party_name' based on whether 'quotation_to' is 'Customer' or 'Lead'.

methods.name: toggle_reqd_lead_customer
methods.description: Toggles required status and query filters for 'party_name' field.

methods.name: address_query
methods.description: Returns address query filters based on linked party.

methods.name: validate_company_and_party
methods.description: Validates that company and party fields are correctly filled.

methods.name: get_lead_details
methods.description: Fetches lead details via server call if 'quotation_to' is 'Lead'.
